description: This Java class models the <condition> element within the OFBiz widget framework, specifically handling 'if-empty-section' conditions and providing a factory for creating condition instances.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition
classes.description: Immutable class representing a screen condition in OFBiz, with nested classes for specific condition types and a factory.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition.IfEmptySection
classes.description: Represents a condition that checks if a specific section is empty within the context.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition.ScreenConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of condition models based on XML elements.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations on this condition.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given context map.

methods.name: getSectionExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the section name.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new condition instance based on the provided XML element.
